english.note: Use this when the person is visibly sullen, grumpy, or showing a glum expression rather than simply feeling sad.
Use this for a sour, sullen, or unfriendly facial expression or demeanor, especially a sour look.
Use 黑面 when someone looks sullen, displeased, or menacing rather than merely dark-coloured.

examples.english: You don't have to look glum; everyone was only joking.
examples.traditional: 你唔使黑面喎，大家都係講笑啫。

examples.english: They turn sour whenever they lose a game.

examples.english: He keeps pulling a black face.
